confirmed_from_code.statement: SPFA._GenerateNextMapImpl gets the tile at the destination via Map.get_Item and calls Tile.IsPassable(MotionMode). A destination tile failing the motion mask is rejected before relaxation.
SPFA.CheckPassableGoto delegates directly to Tile.IsPassableGoTo(MotionMode, Direction); Bresenham raycasts use the same method.
Tile.RefreshTileOptionsViaToken calls Token.get_rewriteTileOptions and, when true, reads Token.get_tileOptions and the keep-current flags, then calls Tile.TryUpdateOptions.

Tile.TryUpdateOptions applies Tile.RewriteOptions, calls Map.UpdateRoutes for WALK and FLY, and calls Map.UpdatePassableMap(Tile) after rewrite. Tile.RestoreOptions follows the same rewrite path with stored options.

Tile.OnCharacterFinished can call Tile.OnTokenFinished; OnTokenFinished calls Tile.RestoreOptionsOnlyViaToken. If Token.get_rewriteTileOptions is true, the method rewrites the tile back to stored origin options.
Enemy.SpecialBlockCondition supports NONE, BUFF_KEY_PAIR_OR, BUFF_KEY_MATCH_AND and FILTER_TAGS. CheckBlockable tests blocker/blockee buff keys or blocker filter tags, not tile ownership.
dump.cs declares Trap : Token and Token : Character; Tile.OnCharacterFinished has a token-specific finish path.

unknown_or_unresolved.reason: The serialized trap_020_roadblock prefab and skill behaviour are not decodable from the encrypted Unity bundles. dump.cs proves the generic Token mechanism, not this prefab's _rewriteTileOptions value or Tile.Options payload.

The ordinary-WALK effect depends on the unresolved prefab payload and possible Enemy.SpecialBlockCondition/FILTER_TAGS configuration. It must not be inferred from deployment occupancy, HP, blockCount or the roadblock name.
Enemy.SpecialBlockCondition.CheckBlockable is the plausible conditional-blocking primitive, but no raw evidence ties sktok_roadblock or the R8-1 roadblock instance to a specific condition instance.
Tile.LocateCharacter -> RefreshTileOptionsViaToken is generic, but the concrete roadblock creation path and payload are not proven.
